article.story: PHOENIX -- — Duke Brennan had 16 points and 10 rebounds to power Grand Canyon to an 88-58 victory over Abilene Christian on Thursday night. Rayshon Harrison scored 14 for the Antelopes (12-5, 2-1 Western Athletic Conference). Tyon Grant-Foster pitched in with 13 points, six rebounds and three steals. The Wildcats (8-10, 0-3) were led by Bradyn Hubbard with 13 points and five steals. Christian Alston added 10 points and Quion Williams scored eight. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
